name: Logo reveal
what: A logo sting: a rounded square drops, lands with a squash, turns into a circle and the letter (or your logo) appears in it, the name fades up under it - or the mark spins in.

learned_from.what: the square at f1, the circle with a letter by f31 at 25 fps, the name under it at f45
the mark spinning in with a word and a small line

motion: drop 12 f (accelerating), squash elastic 10 f, square to circle 14 f (S-curve, a quarter turn), letter back.out 12 f, name 18 f with its spacing closing
